nodes.label: Parent Block Data Retrieved
nodes.description: Parent block's excess_blob_gas, blob_gas_used, and base_fee_per_gas read

nodes.label: Check Reserve Price Condition
nodes.description: Evaluate: BLOB_BASE_COST * parent.base_fee > GAS_PER_BLOB * blob_base_fee

nodes.label: Reserve Condition True
nodes.description: Execution costs dominate - reserve mode applies

nodes.label: Reserve Condition False
nodes.description: Blob fees sufficient - normal mode applies

nodes.label: Calculate Excess (Reserve Mode)
nodes.description: excess += blob_gas_used * (max - target) / max

nodes.label: Calculate Excess (Normal Mode)
nodes.description: excess += blob_gas_used - target_blob_gas

ambiguities.text: The interaction between reserve price mode and the existing EIP-4844 fee mechanism during the transition is not fully specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the reserve price check is evaluated every block, with smooth transitions between modes

ambiguities.text: The formula uses 'max' and 'target' from blobSchedule but the exact parameter names and sources are abbreviated
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume max = MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK and target = TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK from EIP-7840 blobSchedule

implicit_assumptions.description: The ratio of 1/16 (BLOB_BASE_COST / GAS_PER_BLOB) represents an appropriate minimum ratio between blob and execution costs
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Blob fees could be set too high or too low relative to execution costs, affecting rollup economics

implicit_assumptions.description: All clients correctly implement the conditional excess_blob_gas calculation with reserve price logic
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Consensus failures if clients disagree on when reserve mode applies

implicit_assumptions.description: The EIP-7840 blobSchedule mechanism is functioning correctly and provides valid target/max parameters
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Reserve price calculation could use incorrect parameters, leading to unexpected fee behavior

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot manipulate execution gas prices to artificially inflate or deflate blob costs via the reserve price mechanism
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Economic attacks could destabilize blob fee markets by exploiting the execution-to-blob price linkage
